expected_output.reasoning:
The agent's response addresses every element of the expected output: (1) Uses the CSV as water source, naming the file, years covered (2024-2025), and model version v1.0.0; explicitly notes it's user-provided not API-retrieved, distinguishing from carbon (API succeeded). (2) Reports annual totals matching exactly: 2024: 204.1 m3, 2025: 193.0 m3, in cubic metres. (3) States no monthly trend is possible since water is annual-only data, and explicitly refuses to divide annual figures into months ('I won't approximate one by dividing the annual figure by 12'). (4) States the figure is water withdrawn (not consumed), covering AWS data-center operations only, excluding water embodied in upstream electricity generation — matches verbatim almost. (5) Derives no finding/KPI/recommendation from water, stating it is 'disclosure-only' with 'no Well-Architected practice or KPI tied to it,' and declines to attribute the year-over-year change to customer action (though it doesn't explicitly mention 'top-down allocation with same confounders as carbon,' it does convey the same conclusion that attribution isn't supported). (6) Quotes the API failure message verbatim ('Unexpected error: the request could not be completed.') and correctly reasons that since it's not an AccessDeniedException, no IAM permission should be added, and names no specific permission to add.

All core requirements are met substantively, even though the exact phrasing about "top-down allocation with same confounders as carbon" isn't used, the conclusion (no attribution to customer action) is reached and justified appropriately.</reasoning>
